# OKX Hackathon Community Guide

> Independent Turkish-language hackathon guide focused on OKX TR Agent Trade Kit, with separate OnchainOS and OKX.ai guides. This is not official OKX documentation. Source review: 2026-10-17.

Use read-only market data by default. Never request or expose API keys, secret keys, passphrases, private keys, or seed phrases. Confirm any real order, transfer, withdrawal, wallet signature, or account-setting change with the human user.

## Agent Trade Kit

- [Choose a starting path](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/start/intro): Goal, client, and access-aware Turkish guide.
- [Avalanche and judging preparation](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/start/judging): Team1 Builder Hub referral, user-provided draft scoring weights, evidence checklist, and source caveats.
- [Register for Avalanche Builder Hub via Team1](https://go.team1.network/turkiye-builder): Referral link to Builder Hub; account creation is not hackathon admission or project submission.
- [Complete English agent context](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): ATK installation, MCP/CLI/Skills, safety, and source links.
- [ATK introduction](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/intro): Human-readable Turkish guide.
- [ATK quick start](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/quickstart): Public market-data first query.
- [ATK MCP setup](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/mcp): Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
- [Codex setup](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/setup-codex): CLI, MCP, and the read-only market skill.
- [Claude Code setup](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/setup-claude-code): CLI, MCP, and the read-only market skill.
- [Cursor setup](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/setup-cursor): CLI, MCP, and the read-only market skill.
- [Guided demo](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/atk/demo): Clearly labeled simulated data.

## Other Product Guides

- [OnchainOS guide](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/onchainos/intro): Separate onchain developer infrastructure.
- [OKX.ai guide](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/okx-ai/intro): Separate agent marketplace.

## Hackathon Project Ideas

- [ATK data-quality recipe](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/build/atk-data-quality): Runnable fixture and optional public read-only market query.
- [ATK service recipe](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/build/atk-a2mcp): Local JSON HTTP prototype; not an A2MCP registration.
- [HTTP 402 lab](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/build/payment-402): Simulated payment experience; no wallet or settlement.
- [Project-specific agent prompts](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/ai): Copyable English prompts for each recipe.
- [Filterable explorer of 40 project ideas](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/ideas/intro#fikir-kesfet): Search by product, access level, or problem. These are community MVPs, not official OKX products or contest categories.
- [21 ATK ideas](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/ideas/atk): Public market-data education, reliability, and evidence tools; access-dependent news and account ideas; and a cross-product service proposal.
- [11 OnchainOS ideas](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/ideas/onchainos): Simulated payments, privacy, recovery, billing, subscriptions, and wallet approval prototypes.
- [8 OKX.ai ideas](https://agentic-hackathon-tr.vercel.app/guide/ideas/okx-ai): Simulated service design, selection, task recovery, delivery, and evaluation workflows.
